audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer reads Skill on six rows and Orianna on the last; content and packet read Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Ziggs / Orianna / Orianna / Orianna. Four rows render two different answers.
audit.why: The content layer's account is the grounded one: Bouncing Bomb is 850 to your 815, so he owns level 1 and the 4-5 zoning phase, and from 6 onward an immobile mage loses to Shockwave plus a jungler.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Ziggs, phases[3].side -> Ziggs, phases[4].side -> Orianna, phases[5].side -> Orianna, with each moved row's why rewritten to match the new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes listed generic Orianna spikes ('level 6 doubles your lane presence') in the one matchup where level 6 is a concrete kill setup.
audit.why: Satchel Charge (20/18/16/14/12s) is his only escape and it knocks him away rather than moving him toward safety; with no dash, Command: Shockwave at 110s plus a gank converts.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes now names level 6 as the point an immobile Ziggs becomes a kill, and Luden's as roam tempo rather than damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number, and the two supplied missingInteractions do not survive a check against Riot's text.
audit.why: Kit numbers: Satchel Charge 20s->12s at 1000, Hexplosive Minefield 16s at every rank at 900, Bouncing Bomb 6s->4s at 850, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70 at 5000. On the flags: the 'percentHealth' flag on Satchel Charge is contradicted by Riot's own description, which describes a knockback and a turret hexplode and no percent-health damage — so no 'he bypasses resistances' advice was written. Short Fuse is an empowered basic attack whose cooldown drops when he casts, which is not the same thing as an auto-attack reset; the true version of that tell was used instead.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt on Satchel 20s/12s, the flat 16s minefield and your 110s R; dosFull[2].d states that casting speeds up Short Fuse so the empowered auto follows his Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d carried the Satchel Charge line under ball-placement and auto-weave titles, and dontsFull[2].d carried the tradeBad string under a Shockwave title.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten against its own title.

edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.
edits.after: His Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 to your 815, so level 1 he pokes you off the wave and you have no answer. Last-hit safe.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-W every wave contact now. The Dissonance field controls every step he takes near the ball.
edits.after: Q at 4s, minefield at 16s and Satchel at 20s zone you off the wave — take back-edge CS and stop contesting.

edits.before: Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles without casting anything. Every wave he contests is a potential flip.
edits.after: Shockwave online and he is immobile — his only escape is knocking himself away, so R plus a gank kills him.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks a third of his bar. Shove, rotate, and let the ball-delivery threat run the river fights.
edits.after: You roam and he cannot follow: shove with Q-W, leave the lane, and all-in him whenever Satchel is on its 20s.

edits.before: Late Ori is the teamfight: protect-ball on your diver, shockwave their clump, and dissonance the choke they retreat through.
edits.after: He has zero mobility, so the ball goes on your engage and the Shockwave that lands on his clump ends it before he pokes.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by poking from 850, mining the ground you farm on, and never letting you inside your own 815.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Command: Protect like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — it is his only escape, so he is killable for those 20 seconds. - Hexplosive Minefield: 16s at every rank — that is the zone you wait out. - Your R is 110s: spend it on him, not the wave.

edits.before: Lost Chapter steadies the trade game; level 6 doubles your lane presence; Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar.
edits.after: Lost Chapter steadies your mana; level 6 turns an immobile Ziggs into a kill; Luden's buys you the roam tempo.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball — Ziggs has no dash and one 20-second knockback, so the Shockwave that reaches him is the fight and he cannot leave it.

edits.before: His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: A ball on the wave taxes his last-hits and his passive auto, since Short Fuse needs him close.

edits.before: Ziggs spends Satchel Charge early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Short Fuse charges faster every time he casts — expect the empowered auto after his Q.

edits.before: That’s Ziggs’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: An idle ball at 815 leaves you in his minefield with nothing to shield.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Your 110-second R is the answer to an immobile mage — spending it on minions gives back the one edge you actually have.

notes: packet.games and MC_REAL_GAMES agree here (1516), so no defer question. Two supplied missingInteractions were rejected on Riot's own text rather than written into the page: the 'percentHealth' flag on Satchel Charge is contradicted by its description (knockback plus turret hexplode, no percent-health component), and Short Fuse is an empowered basic attack with a cast-shortened cooldown rather than an auto-attack reset — the true form of that tell was used instead. The content layer for this matchup is already Ziggs-specific and accurate and needed no edits; all repairs were in the full layer. phases[N].rating untouched.
